tool.name: search_hotels
tool.description: Search Cambridge accommodation (hotels and guesthouses) using the traveller's requirements. Set each argument from what the traveller has said. Use null for a requirement the traveller has not mentioned, and "any" when the traveller says it doesn't matter. Accommodation type: if the traveller explicitly asks for a guesthouse, or for hotels or guesthouses, honour that exactly. If the traveller has not stated a type preference, search with type ["hotel"] first. If that returns no suitable results, search again with type null so guesthouses are included. Never describe guesthouses inaccurately or discourage a traveller from a type they asked for.

name.description: Name of a specific place to stay, if the traveller gave one; otherwise null.

area.description: Acceptable areas of Cambridge. Null if not mentioned, "any" if the traveller doesn't mind, otherwise the list of acceptable areas.

pricerange.description: Acceptable price ranges. Null if not mentioned, "any" if the traveller doesn't mind, otherwise the list of acceptable price ranges.

stars.description: Acceptable star ratings. Null if not mentioned, "any" if the traveller doesn't mind, otherwise the list of acceptable ratings.

type.description: Accommodation type. If the traveller states a preference, use exactly that: ["guesthouse"], ["hotel"], or "any" if they say either is fine. If they have not stated one, use ["hotel"] on the first search, then null on a follow-up search if no suitable hotel is found.

parking.description: Parking requirement. Null if not mentioned, "any" if the traveller doesn't mind, otherwise ["yes"] or ["no"].

internet.description: Internet requirement. Null if not mentioned, "any" if the traveller doesn't mind, otherwise ["yes"] or ["no"].
